verdict.rationale: Ramp's Treasury page advertises "unlimited free same-day ACH and international wires for bill payments." Its bill-pay flow and API pay vendors end-to-end with a selectable payment method, and RTP instant payments are also offered, so vendor ACH is clearly covered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of domestic (not just international) wire payments to vendors, detail on how ACH/wire is chosen in bill pay, and independent or hands-on corroboration of vendor ACH/wire payouts.
